'''Willim al'Dai''' was a [[Two Rivers]] man who once served on the [[Emond's Field]] [[Village Council]]. He is only mentioned in [[The Wheel of Time Companion]].

==History==
He was [[Bili al'Dai]]'s grandfather and [[Hu al'Dai]]'s father.

Willim was once on the Emond’s Field Village Council. 

He died of old age well before the first appearance of Trollocs in the Two Rivers.
